newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Tractebel to complete Fimeuse merger.
newsitem.headline: Tractebel to complete Fimeuse merger.

text.p: Belgian utility holding company Tractebel SA said on Friday it would complete its planned merger with its Fimeuse unit at an extraordinary shareholders meeting on December 23.

Tractebel, which controls more than 96 percent of Fimeuse following a public offer for its shares earlier this year, said the merger would involve the creation of 10,920 new Tractebel shares with dividend rights from January 1, 1997.
This would bring the total number of Tractebel shares to 13,930,926 shares, it said.
